subject: ddl: abstract decode job args v1 (#56420)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s v1 job-args decode/encode refactor in `pkg/meta/model`: `Job.FillArgs/FillFinishedArgs` now use `getArgsV1/getFinishedArgsV1`, and v1 decoding is centralized via `decodeV1` + `getOrDecodeArgs`. Spot-checked the higher-risk DDL metadata paths (schema/table create/drop, truncate, partition ops including rollback, rename table(s), column add/drop rollback, FK add/drop, recover, placement/TTL/flashback) against the prior layouts; argument orders and compatibility behaviors (e.g. ignored placeholders/extra params) are preserved, and add-index jobs remain on the manual `job.Args` path (not impacted by this change).
